source: MEASURED: real @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js 2.71.0 + stubbed fetch, .ziv/logs/stage-02/survey/probe-wire.mjs -> probe-wire.out (2026-10-07). Field list/meanings: SDK api/resources/textToSpeech/client/requests/BodyTextToSpeechFull.d.ts, api/types/VoiceSettings.d.ts and https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert (accessed 2026-10-07). The voice id JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb is the docs' own example ('George', https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/quickstart) - a premade 'default' voice that expires 2026-12-31.

allBodyFields.text: string, REQUIRED. Per-model maximum: eleven_v4 10,000; eleven_v3 5,000; eleven_multilingual_v2 10,000; eleven_flash_v2_5 40,000; eleven_flash_v2 30,000 (https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models). Longer -> rejected (text_too_long).
allBodyFields.language_code: ISO 639-1; 'If the model does not support the provided language code, it will be ignored. This parameter is not supported for multilingual_v2 models.'
allBodyFields.voice_settings: { stability 0.5, similarity_boost 0.75, style 0, use_speaker_boost true, speed 1 } (defaults); speed 0.7-1.2 (best-practices page); v4: 'Style and Speed sliders are not available'

expect.voiceIsRequired: voice_id is a REQUIRED path segment; the API has no default voice. coax's SpeakRequest.voice is optional - a provider must either have a configured default or fail before the wire.
expect.unknownKeysStripped: The SDK strips request keys it does not know (unknownField absent on the wire - serializer unrecognizedObjectKeys:'strip'); extras reach the body only through requestOptions.additionalBodyParameters (extra_flag present). Same merge point an extraBody would use.
expect.noInstructions: There is no delivery-instruction field. v3/v4 take inline audio tags in the text ('[whispers]', '[laughing]') - the text itself, not a parameter.
expect.speedRange: OpenAI-style speed 0.25-4.0 does not fit 0.7-1.2; values outside are a vendor 400/422 (GUESS: code invalid_voice_settings), not clamped by the SDK.
